goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: Although CLM-703 has only 14 qualifying months, the occupational accident waiver (DIS-POL-04) applies due to a verified factory accident. Work capacity is 25%, and referral to Medical Board is indicated per DIS-POL-01.

story: Young worker CLM-703 claims incapacity following a factory accident with 14 months work history. Check if waiver applies.
starting_sentence: Young worker CLM-703 is claiming incapacity following a factory accident and has only 14 months of work history. Use your tools to evaluate eligibility. Do NOT call pdis_refer_claim — just explain whether and why the standard qualifying condition applies and what disposition you recommend.
